text: A to Z Islamic quiz! Let's see how many you can get. Ready? Let's begin.
What is the day before Eid al-Adha called?
The Day of Arafah.
Who was the first muezzin of Islam?
Bilal, may Allah be pleased with him.
Where did the first revelation come down?
The Cave of Hira.
What do we call a personal supplication to Allah?
Duaa.
Which celebration marks the end of Ramadan?
Eid al-Fitr.
What is the first surah of the Quran?
Al-Fatiha.
Which angel brought the revelation to the Prophet peace be upon him?
Gabriel, Jibreel.
What is the pilgrimage to Makkah called?
Hajj.
Which prophet was commanded to sacrifice his son?
Ibrahim, peace be upon him.
Which day has a special congregational prayer every week?
Jumuah, Friday.
What is the House of Allah in Makkah called?
The Kaaba.
What is the Night of Decree called in Arabic?
Laylatul Qadr.
In which city is the Prophet's Mosque?
Madinah.
Which prophet built the Ark?
Nooh, peace be upon him.
What does the name Al-Fatiha mean?
The Opening.
Which pillar of Islam is performed five times a day?
Prayer, salah.
Which direction do Muslims face when they pray?
The Qibla.
In which month is fasting obligatory?
Ramadan.
What is the meal before dawn on a fasting day called?
Suhoor.
What is the belief in the Oneness of Allah called?
Tawheed.
Which mountain near Madinah gave its name to a famous battle?
Uhud.
What does the word ayah mean in English?
A verse, or a sign.
Which night prayer has an odd number of rakahs?
Witr.
Which prophet was thrown into a well by his brothers?
Yoosuf, peace be upon him.
What is the blessed water near the Kaaba called?
Zamzam.
How many did you get out of twenty five? Tell us in the comments, and send this to a friend.
